extensionDescription.message: Reduce background noise in videos locally and in real time, so voices are easier to hear.

tagline.message: Keep your focus on the voice.

detail_idle.message: Play a video, then enable denoising for the current tab.

detail_starting.message: Loading the audio processor on your device.

detail_running.message: Processing the enabled tab. Denoising continues when this panel closes.

detail_error.message: Try enabling denoising again, or use another tab with audio.

privacy.message: Audio stays on this device. Never recorded or uploaded.

note.message: Best for dialogue and narration. Music and sound effects may change; background music and other voices cannot be fully separated.

errorProcessorTimeout.message: The audio processor is not responding. Stop denoising and try again.

errorProcessorUnresponsive.message: The audio processor stopped responding. Denoising has stopped; try enabling it again.

errorTabBusy.message: Another tab is being denoised. Stop denoising before switching tabs.

errorCaptureTimeout.message: Tab audio authorization timed out. Please try again.

errorNoTab.message: The current tab could not be found.

errorStartTimeout.message: Startup timed out. Stop denoising and try again.

errorSampleRate.message: This device cannot provide the required 48 kHz audio.

errorProcessorStart.message: The denoising processor could not start.

errorNoAudio.message: This tab has no audio available to capture.

errorAudioEnded.message: The tab audio ended, so denoising has stopped.

errorPlaybackInterrupted.message: Audio playback was interrupted, so denoising has stopped.

errorCloseTimeout.message: Closing the audio session timed out.

errorMemory.message: Memory could not be allocated for denoising.

errorInvalidAudio.message: The denoising processor produced invalid audio.

errorUnexpected.message: Could not process this tab. Try again on a regular webpage with audio playing.
